goals: Verify that the GetAllWorkshop API successfully retrieves all workshops when no filters are applied.
Verify that the GetAllWorkshop API correctly filters and returns workshops when queried with single or multiple parameters (e.g., categories, name, description).
activities: Clean up existing workshop data
Insert two test workshops into the database
Send a GET request to the GetAllWorkshop API endpoint
Parse the JSON response body
Verify the response status code is 200 and Content-Type is application/json
Verify the response body status is 200 and message is success
Verify both inserted workshops are present in the response data
Verify 'detail' is not present in the response body
Insert two test workshops with specific categories into the database
Send a GET request to the GetAllWorkshop API endpoint with a category query parameter
Parse the JSON response body
Verify the response status code is 200 and Content-Type is application/json
Verify the response body status is 200 and message is success
Verify the workshop matching the category is present in the response data while the other is not
Verify 'detail' is not present in the response body
Insert four test workshops with various names, descriptions, and categories into the database
Send a GET request to the GetAllWorkshop API endpoint with multiple query parameters for name, description, and categories
Parse the JSON response body
Verify the response status code is 200 and Content-Type is application/json
Verify the response body status is 200 and message is success
Verify the workshops matching the complex criteria are present in the response data while the others are not
Verify 'detail' is not present in the response body
Clean up workshop data during class teardown
